title: LegONet: Plug-and-Play Structure-Preserving Neural Operator Blocks for Compositional PDE Learning
summary: Learned PDE solvers are often trained as monolithic surrogates for a specific equation, boundary condition and discretization. This makes them difficult to reuse when mechanisms change and it can limit stability under long-horizon rollout. We introduce Lego-like Operator Network (LegONet), a compositional framework that builds PDE solvers from plug-and-play, structure-preserving operator blocks defined on shared boundary-adapted spectral representations.
